name: @hayashiii/sitesnap
description: AI-friendly CLI for capturing website screenshots (desktop + mobile) with sitemap support and per-domain organization. Built for portfolio reference collection.

scripts.preinstall:
node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('child_process');const r=spawnSync(process.platform==='win32'?'where':'which',['bun'],{stdio:'ignore'});if(r.status!==0){console.error('
[sitesnap] Bun runtime is required but was not found.
Install: https://bun.sh
  brew install oven-sh/bun/bun
  curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
');process.exit(1)}"

author: Hayashi <hay@shigoto.dev>
